description: Defines classes and methods for handling DNS OPT record data, including various option types such as EdeOpt, PaddingOpt, and UnknownOpt, within the net namespace.

classes.name: OptRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents DNS OPT record data, including various option types and methods for manipulation.

classes.name: OptRecordRdata::Opt
classes.description: Abstract base class for DNS OPT record options.

classes.name: OptRecordRdata::EdeOpt
classes.description: Represents an EDNS Extended DNS Error option.

classes.name: OptRecordRdata::UnknownOpt
classes.description: Represents an unknown or unrecognized OPT option.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an OptRecordRdata object from raw data.

methods.name: AddOpt
methods.description: Adds an option to the OPT record data.

methods.name: ContainsOptCode
methods.description: Checks if an option with the specified code exists.

methods.name: GetOpts
methods.description: Returns all options in insertion order.

methods.name: GetEdeOpts
methods.description: Returns all EDNS Extended DNS Error options.
